rows.Kwic: 諸方野狐禪以達磨對梁王實無功德一語

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Ruibai (入就瑞白禪師語錄), in Ruibai Mingxue's memorial hall address for his late teacher. Ruibai Mingxue is the exact speaker who criticizes 'wild-fox Chan from various quarters' for using Bodhidharma's reply to Emperor Wu of Liang, 'really, no merit,' as a lineage label. Bodhidharma is the quoted case speaker whose words Ruibai discusses, not the speaker of the headword-bearing judgment.
